speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are an infant experiencing recurrent episodes of stridor and wheezing; could you tell me when these symptoms typically occur, such as during feeding, crying, or changes in position?

speaker: Patient
text: 10-month-old boy. The patient has been experiencing recurrent episodes of stridor and wheezing. The mother notes that the wheezing exacerbates when the child is crying, feeding, and when his neck is flexed. Additionally, there are instances where the child vomits after feeding.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Laryngomalacia with possible associated Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD).
